text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal was feeling under the weather,
so she rested in the infirmary..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Guh... Surrounded on all sides by monsters, are we...?
Even for me, against these numbers...!

text_block_list.name: Allied Soldier
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... if only we could regroup with the main force led by our King,
these mere monsters would be nothing...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I forgot that I was lent
a magic tool that summons the strongest reinforcements!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Now is the time! Blow the horn to summon the heroes!

text_block_list.name: Allied Soldier
text_block_list.text: Ring it out!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha-ha!
Didst thou summon me? Didst thou summon meee?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Come now, just give me ten thousand troops, and with my brilliant god-tier tactics, it'll be a piece of cake—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...The only allies we have are the ones right here, though?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, no way, no way.
If anything, I'm more of the military strategist type, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Why do you have a conch shell?!
Ugh, re-summon it! Blow the whistle properly this time!

text_block_list.name: Allied Soldier
text_block_list.text: Ring it out!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"My melody shall resound across the world!
Si comincia!
The grand concert of a lifetime... Here is my ultimate piece!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Though your opponent isn't a human, but a monster.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Alas, my melody cannot reach those who do not understand music... In other words, I am powerless!
An elegy is playing within my heart...!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Jeez! Besides, this isn't even a flute, is it?!
Where's the flute to summon the king's reinforcements?!

text_block_list.name: Allied Soldier
text_block_list.text: This is it! Sound it out—!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My King, my Lord...!
I had faith in you...!

text_block_list.name: My King
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Durandal!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Hear me, everyone! We are before our King!
Now is the time to display our valor!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
――……
Just a dream, huh.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "My King!? ...Ah, no, Lord Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Most certainly!
For as a knight, I was able to serve my King!
